# ABI bundle

abi.js is generated from src/abi.js by pinned esbuild and viem versions in package-lock.json. viem is MIT licensed, https://github.com/wevm/viem. Its source license and transitive dependency notices are retained in this directory and the generated bundle. This bundles read-only ABI codecs, not a wallet or provider client.

Bundled abitype is MIT, copyright weth, LLC, https://github.com/wevm/abitype. Its full license is LICENSE.abitype. Bundled @noble/hashes is MIT, copyright Paul Miller, https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes. Its full license is LICENSE.noble-hashes. The full viem license is LICENSE.viem. These third-party files retain their upstream wording.
